title: Execution brain memory seam uses local live state and git durable state
summary: Decision from the user conversation: separate execution from brain/memory. Execution owns live process/session/worktree/lease state locally; brain/memory owns planning, context assembly, retrieval, durable decisions, and summaries. Git-synced state should store durable coordination/audit/results such as tasks, deps, summaries, branches, commits, and terminal verdicts, not authoritative process liveness. Claim records in git must be treated as durable intent/audit with leases, while local daemon state determines which agent is alive right now. This supports many workspaces per machine, single-repo and multi-repo workspaces, and collaborators syncing over git.
